proof_0409.moves: Pure definitional unfolding: the value of the exponential map on the fundamental cone at a point is by definition the coordinatewise exponential, so the proof is rfl. No mathematical step beyond unfolding the partial-homeomorph coercion.

proof_0410.moves: The coercion of the constant modular form to a function is the constant function, true by definition; the proof is Eq.refl after unfolding the FunLike coercion. All the group/matrix scaffolding is just the ambient setting.

proof_0411.moves: Splitting of p * X is the same as splitting of X * p, so commute the product and quote the already-proved X * p version; the rest is simp closing an iff by reflexivity.

proof_0412.moves: Adding a fixed constant is a measurable map, so composing it with an identically-distributed pair preserves identical distribution: apply the composition lemma with measurability of const-add.

proof_0413.moves: Real exp is the restriction of complex exp to the reals; since complex exp is smooth as a complex function, the real-of-complex transfer lemma gives smoothness of the real one.

proof_0414.moves: Two directions: forward, a conjugate root produces an algebra equivalence carrying one to the other (the normality/minimal-polynomial content); backward, any algebra equivalence sends a root to a conjugate root, with a symmetry step to orient it. The Iff.intro plus destructuring of the existential is packaging.

proof_0415.moves: Negation is a measurable map, so precomposing an a.e.-measurable function with it (composition of measurable with aemeasurable) is again a.e. measurable.

proof_0416.moves: The iff form of extensionality: backward direction is the already-proved ext lemma, forward direction is just congruence on the coercion. The real content is the ext lemma; everything else is equality/subst plumbing.

proof_0417.moves: Preservation of the pullback for one arm of the cospan follows from preservation for the other by the symmetry of pullbacks; the proof just transports the existing instance across that symmetry.

proof_0418.moves: Meromorphy on a set is meromorphy at each point, so fix a point and apply the pointwise quotient lemma for meromorphic germs.

proof_0419.moves: The trivialization at a point of a vector bundle core is by definition the local trivialization at the index of that point, so the statement reduces to the already-proved localTriv version of the symmL formula.

proof_0420.moves: Smoothness is pointwise smoothness, so rewrite both hypotheses and the goal through contDiff_iff_contDiffAt and apply the pointwise product-map lemma at each point of the product.

proof_0421.moves: The Stieltjes function built from a measurable rational CDF is nonnegative; the proof just supplies the instance saying toRatCDF really is a measurable rational CDF and quotes the general nonnegativity lemma.

proof_0422.moves: The representative of a rational map is defined by choice from the existence statement, so its defining property is exactly Exists.choose_spec applied to exists_rep. The whole content is unpacking that choice.

proof_0423.moves: At exponent infinity the eLpNorm is the essential sup, so the statement is the already-proved essential-sup formula for a piecewise function, transported through that identification.

proof_0424.moves: The coercion from reals to extended reals is measurable, so composing it with an a.e.-measurable function keeps a.e. measurability.

proof_0425.moves: Membership in the support is tested on a neighbourhood basis; take the tautological basis of the neighbourhood filter and feed it to the has-basis characterisation of the support, turning it into a statement over all basis sets.

proof_0426.moves: Cast the natural number to an integer (the casts agree in the reals) and invoke the integer version of the same inequality; the only step is the cast bookkeeping.

proof_0427.moves: A probability measure's underlying finite measure has the same values on sets by construction, so the coercion identity holds by rfl. Definitional unfolding only.

proof_0428.moves: The quotient map is surjective and continuous (continuity for the coinduced topology is automatic), so path-connectedness transfers from the space to its quotient via the surjective-image lemma.

proof_0429.moves: The unit of the operator-norm algebra of continuous linear maps is the identity map, and the identity has operator norm one on a nontrivial space; construct the NormOneClass instance from that.

proof_0430.moves: The interior is open and contained in the null set, so by monotonicity it is null too; an open null set in a space with the open-positive-measure property must be empty.

proof_0431.moves: Swapping coordinates is a measurable equivalence whose inverse is itself, so comap along swap equals map along its symm by the general comap-symm lemma for measurable equivalences.

proof_0432.moves: Use that the map is measure-preserving to replace the pushforward measure by the original, then move the restricted integral across the measurable embedding using the map-restriction and lintegral-under-embedding lemmas; the rest is rewriting.
